episodes.title: Seocho-Dong
episodes.summary: Hui-ji joins the lunch crew of the Hyungmin Building associates. She seems to recognize Ju-hyeong.

episodes.title: More Than Meets the Eye
episodes.summary: Hui Ji remembers Ju Hyeong, but he doesn't remember her. They clash over opposing sides of an issue.

episodes.title: How to Separate Work From Personal Life
episodes.summary: Ju Hyeong and Hui Ji make peace. The firms merge, and Hui Ji grapples with a medical malpractice case.

episodes.title: None of My Business
episodes.summary: Hui Ji learns the opposing side in Ju Hyeong's case is his ex. The group faces troubling situations.

episodes.title: The Courage to Face It
episodes.summary: Ju-hyeong admits post-divorce feelings to Hui-ji but Chang-won's help with her job irks him. Mun-jeong doubts pregnancy. Sang-gi gets odd texts post-leak.

episodes.title: A Few Words of Kindness
episodes.summary: Sang-gi's exposé creates group tension, he reveals his past. Ju-hyeong and Hui-ji bond, seeing Hyeong-min anew. Mun-jeong dreads telling Ji-seok of the baby.

episodes.title: The One Who Truly Understands Me
episodes.summary: Ju-hyeong finds ease in familiar faces, grows love for Hui-ji. Hyeong-min mentors while Sang-gi enjoys teaching law students. Chang-won questions justice.

episodes.title: The Others I'm Close To
episodes.summary: Hui-ji's world shatters as her father is jailed for fraud. Old wounds reopen. She turns to Ju-hyeong for help. The group unites to stand by her side.

episodes.title: If You Ask What My Dream Is
episodes.summary: Mun-jeong finds purpose in a case. Hyeong-min hits limits helping a scam victim. Sang-gi faces PhD reality. Chang-won questions being an advocate.

episodes.title: Difference in Perspective
episodes.summary: Chang-won finds hope in a trial. Mun-jeong resists quitting. Ju-hyeong takes an unwanted case, facing discomfort. Hui-ji defends a child's life.

episodes.title: Being an Adult
episodes.summary: Man-su asks Ju-hyeong to help reclaim land. Sang-gi meets someone who's just ike his past self. Hui-ji defends a murder suspect. Change stirs in Hyeong-min.

episodes.title: See You in Seocho-dong
episodes.summary: After Man-su's funeral, Ju-hyeong questions the case. Chang-won and Sang-gi share news. Hui-ji and Hyeong-min face choices. The five choose their paths.
